frameworks.name: Core Four Advertising Methods
frameworks.definition: Four fundamental channels for customer acquisition: outreach (direct), paid ads, content, and affiliate outreach.

claims.text: For wedding photography businesses, wedding planners and event coordinators are the optimal affiliate partners because the end customer (bride/groom) is already asking for referrals within this trusted network locally.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi

claims.text: Offering wedding planners 100% of revenue on the first one or two customer referrals (with zero commission retention by the photographer) creates initial incentive for the planner to actively promote the photographer without financial risk.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
claims.mechanism: Planner avoids revenue risk on initial trials and gains confidence in photographer quality before committing to a shared-revenue model.

claims.text: Wedding planners and event coordinators, once converted into reliable referral partners, become stable distribution nodes that repeatedly feed customer referrals to the photographer.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi

examples.text: A photographer seeking to scale a wedding photography business would approach local wedding planners with an offer to provide photography at any price the planner can negotiate with the end customer, allowing the planner to keep 100% of the negotiated fee on the first one or two referrals. After the photographer proves their quality through these initial jobs, the photographer and planner then establish a long-term deal structure (e.g., commission split or tiered pricing). By repeating this pattern across multiple wedding planners, the photographer builds a network where each planner becomes an ongoing distribution node continuously referring new customers.

practices.text: When building affiliate relationships in service businesses with local referral networks, identify and recruit the natural gatekeepers and decision-influencers in your target market first.

For photography and event-based services, prioritize affiliate/partner channel development through targeted outreach to wedding planners and coordinators over paid advertising or cold outreach to individual consumers.
